properties.name: AutoSize
properties.defaultValue: false when created in code (the designer sets it to true)
properties.description: Makes the label resize itself to fit its text.
properties.usage: Keep it on for simple captions; turn it off when you need a fixed-size or wrapped text area.
properties.expectedEffect: With AutoSize off the label keeps its Size, so long text wraps or is clipped.

properties.name: TextAlign
properties.acceptedValues: TopLeft, TopCenter, TopRight, MiddleLeft, MiddleCenter, MiddleRight, BottomLeft, BottomCenter, BottomRight
properties.description: Where the text sits inside the label's area.
properties.usage: Center a heading in a wide label or right-align numbers.
properties.expectedEffect: The text moves inside the label. You only notice it when AutoSize is off and the label is larger than the text.

properties.name: Image
properties.description: A picture drawn inside the label, positioned with ImageAlign.
properties.usage: Show a small icon next to a status message.
properties.expectedEffect: The picture appears in the label together with the text.

properties.name: BorderStyle
properties.description: The border drawn around the label.
properties.usage: Make a label look like a read-only field.
properties.expectedEffect: A thin line (or a sunken edge for Fixed3D) surrounds the label.

properties.name: UseMnemonic
properties.description: Treats an ampersand (&) in Text as the marker for an underlined access key.
properties.usage: Set it to false when the text must show a literal ampersand, such as "Q&A".
properties.expectedEffect: The ampersand is shown as normal text instead of underlining the next letter.

properties.name: FlatStyle
properties.description: Selects how the button is drawn.
properties.usage: Use Flat when you want full control of colors and a modern look.
properties.expectedEffect: The button loses its 3-D look and uses FlatAppearance settings for border and hover colors.

properties.name: DialogResult
properties.acceptedValues: None, OK, Cancel, Abort, Retry, Ignore, Yes, No (plus Continue and TryAgain in newer versions)
properties.description: The value handed back to the form when the button is clicked on a dialog.
properties.usage: Give OK and Cancel buttons a DialogResult so you need no Click handler to close the dialog.
properties.expectedEffect: Clicking the button closes a form shown with ShowDialog, and ShowDialog returns that value.

properties.name: Image
properties.description: A picture shown on the button, positioned with ImageAlign and TextImageRelation.
properties.usage: Add an icon to Save, Print or Delete buttons.
properties.expectedEffect: The icon is drawn on the button, next to the text if you also set TextImageRelation.

properties.name: UseVisualStyleBackColor
properties.description: When true, Windows visual styles draw the button and BackColor is ignored.
properties.usage: Set it to false before changing BackColor, otherwise your color has no effect.
properties.expectedEffect: The button now honors BackColor.

properties.name: Text
properties.acceptedValues: Any string; use Environment.NewLine for line breaks when Multiline is true
properties.description: The characters currently in the box, which is what the user typed.
properties.usage: Read it when the user submits a form, and trim it before use.
properties.expectedEffect: Assigning a value replaces the box content and raises TextChanged.

properties.name: Multiline
properties.description: Allows several lines of text. Enter then inserts a new line.
properties.usage: Use it for notes, comments and logs.
properties.expectedEffect: The box can be made taller and Enter starts a new line.

properties.name: ReadOnly
properties.description: Stops the user from changing the text while still letting them select and copy it.
properties.usage: Show an ID or a calculated result the user may copy but not edit.
properties.expectedEffect: Typing is ignored; the text stays selectable.

properties.name: MaxLength
properties.acceptedValues: 0 or greater (0 means the default limit)
properties.description: The maximum number of characters the user can type.
properties.usage: Limit a postal code or a code field to its real length.
properties.expectedEffect: Extra typing is ignored. Code can still assign longer text.

properties.name: PasswordChar
properties.description: A character displayed in place of every typed character.
properties.usage: Hide a password. It has no effect when Multiline is true.
properties.expectedEffect: Each typed character appears as *.

properties.name: UseSystemPasswordChar
properties.description: Uses the operating system's password dot and overrides PasswordChar.
properties.usage: Prefer it over PasswordChar for consistent looks and for blocking copy.
properties.expectedEffect: Typed characters appear as dots and the text cannot be copied.

properties.name: PlaceholderText
properties.description: Gray hint text shown while the box is empty and unfocused.
properties.usage: Tell users what to type, such as "Search...".
properties.expectedEffect: The hint disappears as soon as the user types.

properties.name: WordWrap
properties.description: Wraps long lines onto the next line in a multiline box.
properties.usage: Turn it off for logs or code where line breaks matter.
properties.expectedEffect: Long lines run past the edge; set ScrollBars to Horizontal or Both to scroll.

properties.name: Rtf
properties.description: The content including its formatting, as RTF.
properties.usage: Load or save a formatted document.
properties.expectedEffect: Fonts, colors and alignment from the RTF appear in the box.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: The plain text of the box without formatting.
properties.usage: Read the words only, for searching or counting.
properties.expectedEffect: Setting Text replaces the content and removes earlier formatting.

properties.name: SelectionFont
properties.defaultValue: null when the selection has mixed fonts
properties.description: The font of the selected text, or of the text typed at the caret if nothing is selected.
properties.usage: Implement Bold and Italic buttons.
properties.expectedEffect: The selected text becomes bold.

properties.name: SelectionColor
properties.defaultValue: Color.Empty when the selection has mixed colors
properties.description: The color of the selected text or of the next typed text.
properties.usage: Highlight a keyword or an error in a log.
properties.expectedEffect: The selected text turns red.

properties.name: SelectionAlignment
properties.description: Alignment of the selected paragraphs.
properties.usage: Center a title paragraph.
properties.expectedEffect: The paragraphs containing the selection move to the center.

properties.name: ReadOnly
properties.description: Prevents editing while keeping the formatted text visible and selectable.
properties.usage: Display formatted help text or a license.
properties.expectedEffect: Typing is ignored; code can still change the content.

properties.name: WordWrap
properties.description: Wraps long lines at the edge of the control.
properties.usage: Disable it for code or tabular text.
properties.expectedEffect: Lines extend past the edge and a horizontal scroll bar can appear.

properties.name: Mask
properties.acceptedValues: Mask characters such as 0 (digit required), 9 (digit optional), L (letter required), ? (letter optional), A (alphanumeric required) and literals
properties.description: The pattern every entry must follow.
properties.usage: Force a phone number, date or postal code to a fixed layout.
properties.expectedEffect: The box shows the pattern with prompt characters and accepts only matching input.

properties.name: MaskCompleted
properties.description: True when every required position of the mask has been filled.
properties.usage: Check it before accepting the form.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns false while required positions are still empty.

properties.name: PromptChar
properties.description: The character shown for positions that are still empty.
properties.usage: Use a different prompt, such as '#', to match your design.
properties.expectedEffect: Empty positions show # instead of _.

properties.name: Text
properties.defaultValue: The prompt characters and literals of the mask
properties.acceptedValues: Any text that satisfies the mask
properties.description: The entered text, formatted according to TextMaskFormat.
properties.usage: Read the value after validating with MaskCompleted.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns the text in the format chosen by TextMaskFormat.

properties.name: TextMaskFormat
properties.description: Controls whether Text contains the literals and prompt characters of the mask.
properties.usage: Use ExcludePromptAndLiterals when you want only the typed digits.
properties.expectedEffect: Text returns digits only, for example 5551234567.

properties.name: ValidatingType
properties.acceptedValues: typeof(DateTime), typeof(int), or any type with a static Parse method
properties.description: The type the entered text must be convertible to.
properties.usage: Validate a date mask when the user leaves the box.
properties.expectedEffect: TypeValidationCompleted is raised after the user leaves the box and tells you whether parsing worked.

properties.name: Checked
properties.acceptedValues: true, false (true also for the Indeterminate state)
properties.description: Whether the box is ticked.
properties.usage: Read it to find out the user's choice.
properties.expectedEffect: Setting it ticks or clears the box and raises CheckedChanged.

properties.name: CheckState
properties.description: The full state of the box, including the third state.
properties.usage: Show "some items selected" in a select-all box.
properties.expectedEffect: A filled square appears instead of a tick.

properties.name: ThreeState
properties.description: Lets the user cycle through Unchecked, Checked and Indeterminate by clicking.
properties.usage: Use it for options that can be on, off or "not set".
properties.expectedEffect: Each click moves to the next of the three states.

properties.name: AutoCheck
properties.description: Whether a click changes the state automatically.
properties.usage: Turn it off when your code must confirm the change first.
properties.expectedEffect: Clicks no longer toggle the box; your code sets Checked itself.

properties.name: Appearance
properties.description: Draws the check box as a normal box or as a toggle button.
properties.usage: Build toolbar-like toggles such as Bold.
properties.expectedEffect: The control looks like a button that stays pressed while checked.

properties.name: Checked
properties.description: Whether this option is selected. Selecting it clears the others in the same container.
properties.usage: Read which option is chosen.
properties.expectedEffect: Setting it to true selects this option and deselects its siblings.

properties.name: AutoCheck
properties.description: Whether a click selects the button automatically.
properties.usage: Turn it off when you must validate the choice first.
properties.expectedEffect: Clicks no longer change the selection; code must set Checked.

properties.name: Appearance
properties.description: Draws the option as a round button or as a toggle button.
properties.usage: Create segmented choices such as Day / Week / Month.
properties.expectedEffect: The option looks like a push button that stays pressed when chosen.

properties.name: Items
properties.acceptedValues: Any objects (text is taken from ToString or DisplayMember)
properties.description: The list of choices.
properties.usage: Fill the list from code.
properties.expectedEffect: The drop-down shows the three entries.

properties.name: SelectedIndex
properties.acceptedValues: -1 (nothing) up to Items.Count - 1; other values throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException
properties.description: Zero-based position of the selected entry.
properties.usage: Select a default entry or test whether anything is selected.
properties.expectedEffect: The first entry is shown and SelectedIndexChanged is raised.

properties.name: SelectedItem
properties.description: The selected entry itself.
properties.usage: Read the chosen value.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns the chosen object, or null when nothing is selected.

properties.name: DropDownStyle
properties.description: Whether the user may type text or only pick from the list.
properties.usage: Use DropDownList when only listed values are valid.
properties.expectedEffect: The text area becomes read-only and only the listed entries can be chosen.

properties.name: DataSource
properties.acceptedValues: An IList or IListSource such as an array, List<T>, DataTable or BindingSource
properties.description: Binds the list to a collection instead of filling Items manually.
properties.usage: Show database or business objects.
properties.expectedEffect: The list shows one entry per object in the collection.

properties.name: DisplayMember
properties.acceptedValues: The name of a property of the bound objects
properties.description: The property whose value is shown for each entry.
properties.usage: Show a name instead of the object's type name.
properties.expectedEffect: The list displays each object's Name.

properties.name: ValueMember
properties.acceptedValues: The name of a property of the bound objects
properties.description: The property returned by SelectedValue.
properties.usage: Keep an ID behind each visible name.
properties.expectedEffect: SelectedValue returns the Id of the chosen object.

properties.name: AutoCompleteMode
properties.description: Offers or completes matches while the user types. It also needs AutoCompleteSource and does not work with DropDownList.
properties.usage: Help users find an entry in a long list.
properties.expectedEffect: Matching entries are suggested and the rest of the word is filled in.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: The text in the edit area. With DropDownList it matches the selected entry.
properties.usage: Read what the user typed in a DropDown combo box.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns the visible text, whether typed or chosen.

properties.name: Items
properties.description: The entries shown in the list.
properties.usage: Add entries from code.
properties.expectedEffect: A new line appears at the end of the list.

properties.name: SelectedIndex
properties.description: Zero-based index of the selected entry (the first selected one in multi-select mode).
properties.usage: Test whether anything is selected.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns -1 when nothing is selected.

properties.name: SelectedItem
properties.description: The selected entry itself.
properties.usage: Read the chosen value.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns the chosen object, or null.

properties.name: SelectedItems
properties.description: All selected entries when multi-select is enabled.
properties.usage: Process every selected entry.
properties.expectedEffect: Enumerates every highlighted entry.

properties.name: SelectionMode
properties.description: How many entries the user may select and how.
properties.usage: Use MultiExtended for Ctrl and Shift selection.
properties.expectedEffect: Ctrl-click and Shift-click select several entries.

properties.name: Sorted
properties.description: Keeps the entries in alphabetical order.
properties.usage: Show a list that must always be ordered.
properties.expectedEffect: New entries are inserted in order and indexes change accordingly.

properties.name: DataSource
properties.description: Binds the list to a collection.
properties.usage: Display a list of business objects.
properties.expectedEffect: One line is shown per object (use DisplayMember to choose the text).

properties.name: Items
properties.description: The entries shown in the list, each with a check box.
properties.usage: Add an entry and decide whether it starts checked.
properties.expectedEffect: A new entry appears with its box already ticked.

properties.name: CheckedItems
properties.description: The entries whose boxes are ticked.
properties.usage: Collect the user's choices.
properties.expectedEffect: Enumerates only the ticked entries.

properties.name: CheckedIndices
properties.description: The zero-based indexes of the ticked entries.
properties.usage: Save which positions are ticked.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns how many entries are ticked.

properties.name: CheckOnClick
properties.description: Ticks or clears a box with a single click instead of first selecting the entry.
properties.usage: Make the list feel like a normal group of check boxes.
properties.expectedEffect: One click toggles the box.

properties.name: SelectionMode
properties.acceptedValues: One, None (multi-select modes are not supported)
properties.description: How the highlight bar behaves. Ticking is independent of it.
properties.usage: Use CheckedItems, not multi-select, to pick several entries.
properties.expectedEffect: No entry can be highlighted, but boxes can still be ticked.

properties.name: Image
properties.description: The picture displayed.
properties.usage: Show a logo, photo or generated bitmap.
properties.expectedEffect: The picture is drawn according to SizeMode.

properties.name: ImageLocation
properties.acceptedValues: A file path or an URL
properties.description: A location the control loads the picture from.
properties.usage: Show a picture from the web without writing download code.
properties.expectedEffect: The picture is loaded (in the background by default) and displayed.

properties.name: SizeMode
properties.description: How the picture is fitted into the control.
properties.usage: Use Zoom to fit a picture without distortion.
properties.expectedEffect: The picture is scaled to fit while keeping its aspect ratio.

properties.name: BorderStyle
properties.description: The border drawn around the control.
properties.usage: Frame a thumbnail.
properties.expectedEffect: A thin line surrounds the picture.

properties.name: Value
properties.defaultValue: The current date and time when the control is created
properties.acceptedValues: A DateTime between MinDate and MaxDate
properties.description: The date and time currently chosen.
properties.usage: Read the chosen date or preset it.
properties.expectedEffect: The control shows the new date and raises ValueChanged.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: How the value is displayed.
properties.usage: Use Short for compact dates and Time for time entry.
properties.expectedEffect: The date is shown in the short format of the user's regional settings.

properties.name: CustomFormat
properties.acceptedValues: Format strings such as "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm" (needs Format = Custom)
properties.description: A custom display pattern.
properties.usage: Show dates in a fixed layout.
properties.expectedEffect: The control displays the date in your pattern when Format is Custom.

properties.name: MinDate
properties.description: The earliest date the user can choose.
properties.usage: Block dates in the past.
properties.expectedEffect: Earlier dates cannot be selected.

properties.name: MaxDate
properties.description: The latest date the user can choose.
properties.usage: Limit a booking window.
properties.expectedEffect: Later dates cannot be selected.

properties.name: ShowUpDown
properties.description: Shows a spin button instead of the drop-down calendar.
properties.usage: Use it for time entry.
properties.expectedEffect: The calendar button is replaced by up/down arrows.

properties.name: ShowCheckBox
properties.description: Shows a check box that tells whether a date is set at all. Read Checked for its state.
properties.usage: Make the date optional.
properties.expectedEffect: A check box appears left of the date; clear it for "no date".

properties.name: SelectionStart
properties.acceptedValues: Any date within MinDate and MaxDate
properties.description: First day of the selected range.
properties.usage: Read or set the chosen date.
properties.expectedEffect: The calendar highlights that day.

properties.name: SelectionEnd
properties.acceptedValues: Any date within MinDate and MaxDate
properties.description: Last day of the selected range.
properties.usage: Read the end of a multi-day selection.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns the last selected day.

properties.name: SelectionRange
properties.acceptedValues: Any range up to MaxSelectionCount days
properties.description: Start and end of the selection together.
properties.usage: Select a whole week from code.
properties.expectedEffect: All days in the range are highlighted.

properties.name: MaxSelectionCount
properties.description: The largest number of days the user can select.
properties.usage: Set it to 1 for single-date choice.
properties.expectedEffect: The user can select only one day.

properties.name: ShowToday
properties.description: Shows the "Today" line at the bottom.
properties.usage: Hide it for a cleaner calendar.
properties.expectedEffect: The Today line disappears.

properties.name: BoldedDates
properties.description: Days shown in bold, such as holidays or events.
properties.usage: Mark days that have appointments.
properties.expectedEffect: Those days appear in bold.

properties.name: Value
properties.acceptedValues: A number from Minimum to Maximum; others throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException
properties.description: The current number.
properties.usage: Read the quantity the user chose.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns the number as a decimal.

properties.name: Minimum
properties.description: The smallest allowed value.
properties.usage: Prevent negative quantities.
properties.expectedEffect: The value cannot go below 1.

properties.name: Maximum
properties.description: The largest allowed value.
properties.usage: Limit a quantity to the available stock.
properties.expectedEffect: The value cannot go above 10.

properties.name: Increment
properties.description: The step applied by the arrows and the arrow keys.
properties.usage: Step in 0.5 or 10.
properties.expectedEffect: Each arrow click changes the value by 0.5.

properties.name: DecimalPlaces
properties.description: How many digits follow the decimal point.
properties.usage: Show prices with two decimals.
properties.expectedEffect: The value is displayed as 12.50.

properties.name: ThousandsSeparator
properties.description: Shows group separators in large numbers.
properties.usage: Make big numbers easier to read.
properties.expectedEffect: The value is displayed as 1,000,000.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: The current progress.
properties.usage: Update it as work advances.
properties.expectedEffect: The filled part of the bar grows to 40 percent for the default range.

properties.name: Minimum
properties.description: The value that represents an empty bar.
properties.usage: Use a custom range such as 1 to 12.
properties.expectedEffect: Sets the lower end of the range.

properties.name: Maximum
properties.description: The value that represents a full bar.
properties.usage: Set it to the number of items to process.
properties.expectedEffect: The bar is full when Value equals the number of files.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Draws the bar in blocks, as a smooth bar, or as an endlessly moving marquee.
properties.usage: Use Marquee when the duration is unknown.
properties.expectedEffect: A block moves back and forth continuously.

properties.name: Step
properties.description: The amount PerformStep adds to Value.
properties.usage: Advance by one item at a time.
properties.expectedEffect: Each call to PerformStep adds 1.

properties.name: MarqueeAnimationSpeed
properties.description: The delay between marquee animation updates. It only matters when Style is Marquee.
properties.usage: Slow down or stop the marquee.
properties.expectedEffect: A smaller number makes the block move faster; 0 stops it.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: The position of the slider.
properties.usage: Read the chosen level.
properties.expectedEffect: Setting it moves the slider and raises ValueChanged.

properties.name: Minimum
properties.description: The value at the left (or bottom) end.
properties.usage: Define the lower limit.
properties.expectedEffect: Sets the smallest slider value.

properties.name: Maximum
properties.description: The value at the right (or top) end.
properties.usage: Use 100 for percentages.
properties.expectedEffect: The slider now covers 0 to 100.

properties.name: TickFrequency
properties.description: The distance between tick marks, in value units.
properties.usage: Show a tick every ten units.
properties.expectedEffect: Tick marks appear every 10 units.

properties.name: TickStyle
properties.description: Where the tick marks are drawn.
properties.usage: Hide ticks for a clean slider.
properties.expectedEffect: The tick marks disappear.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Direction of the slider.
properties.usage: Build a vertical volume slider.
properties.expectedEffect: The slider turns upright.

properties.name: SmallChange
properties.description: The change caused by the arrow keys.
properties.usage: Use finer keyboard control.
properties.expectedEffect: Each arrow key press moves the value by 1.

properties.name: LargeChange
properties.description: The change caused by PageUp, PageDown or a click beside the thumb.
properties.usage: Move faster with the keyboard.
properties.expectedEffect: Page keys move the value by 10.

properties.name: Links
properties.defaultValue: One link covering all the text
properties.acceptedValues: Link objects with a start and a length
properties.description: The clickable parts of the text.
properties.usage: Make only a part of a sentence clickable.
properties.expectedEffect: Only the five characters from position 14 are shown and handled as a link.

properties.name: LinkColor
properties.description: The color of unvisited links.
properties.usage: Match the link color to your theme.
properties.expectedEffect: Links are drawn in the new color.

properties.name: VisitedLinkColor
properties.description: The color of links whose LinkVisited is true.
properties.usage: Show which links were already used.
properties.expectedEffect: Visited links change to the new color.

properties.name: LinkBehavior
properties.description: When the link text is underlined.
properties.usage: Underline only on hover for a cleaner look.
properties.expectedEffect: The underline appears when the pointer is over the link.

properties.name: LinkVisited
properties.description: Marks the first link as visited.
properties.usage: Set it after the user has opened the link.
properties.expectedEffect: The link switches to VisitedLinkColor.

properties.name: Active
properties.description: Turns all tool tips of this component on or off.
properties.usage: Let users disable help pop-ups.
properties.expectedEffect: No tool tip appears while it is false.

properties.name: AutoPopDelay
properties.description: How long the tool tip stays visible while the pointer rests.
properties.usage: Keep long hints on screen for longer.
properties.expectedEffect: The tip disappears after 8 seconds.

properties.name: InitialDelay
properties.description: How long the pointer must rest before the tip appears.
properties.usage: Show hints faster.
properties.expectedEffect: The tip appears after 0.2 seconds.

properties.name: ReshowDelay
properties.description: The delay before the tip appears when moving from one control to another.
properties.usage: Make moving between controls feel smoother.
properties.expectedEffect: Tips follow the pointer more quickly.

properties.name: IsBalloon
properties.description: Shows the tip as a balloon with a pointer instead of a rectangle.
properties.usage: Use balloon tips for friendly hints.
properties.expectedEffect: The tip is drawn as a rounded balloon.

properties.name: ShowAlways
properties.description: Shows tips even when the owner form is not active.
properties.usage: Show hints in tool windows.
properties.expectedEffect: Tips appear even if the form is in the background.

properties.name: ToolTipTitle
properties.description: A bold title shown above the tip text.
properties.usage: Add a heading to important tips.
properties.expectedEffect: A title line is shown above the text.

properties.name: ToolTipIcon
properties.description: An icon shown beside the title. It only appears when ToolTipTitle is set.
properties.usage: Signal the kind of message.
properties.expectedEffect: An information icon is shown next to the title.

properties.name: BlinkStyle
properties.description: When the error icon blinks to attract attention.
properties.usage: Stop the icon from blinking if it distracts.
properties.expectedEffect: The icon stays steady.

properties.name: BlinkRate
properties.description: The blink interval of the icon.
properties.usage: Slow the blinking down.
properties.expectedEffect: The icon blinks every half second.

properties.name: Icon
properties.defaultValue: A red circle with an exclamation mark
properties.description: The icon shown next to an invalid control.
properties.usage: Use your own error symbol.
properties.expectedEffect: Your icon replaces the default one.

properties.name: ContainerControl
properties.defaultValue: The owning form when created by the designer
properties.description: The container whose controls the provider decorates. When you create the provider in code, set it yourself.
properties.usage: Make the provider work when created in code.
properties.expectedEffect: Error icons now appear on controls of this form.

properties.name: DataSource
properties.acceptedValues: An object that implements IDataErrorInfo, or a binding source
properties.description: A data source from which error messages are read automatically.
properties.usage: Show validation errors from your data classes.
properties.expectedEffect: Errors reported by the data objects appear on the bound controls.
